_readme: Hand corrections for tools/build-modelnames.py. Merged LAST, so a fix here survives
regeneration. Never hand-edit GTA/scripts/gta11y-modelnames.tsv.gz — correct it here.
model   the model name; its joaat is computed for you (omit if you give hash)
hash    signed int32, use when the model name is unknown or was relabelled
name    what the screen reader should say. This is heard, not read.
kind    p = ped, o = object, d = door/gate, x = other. Omit to keep the derived one.
gxt     ped rows only: a GXT key resolved live so the name localizes.
status  refuted = drop the row entirely (a name that is wrong is worse than none).
evidence  why. Same provenance model as tools/worlddata-overrides.json.
Seeded from what the generator provably gets wrong. Everything else waits for a
session to show it matters — see gta11y-modelgaps-*.log at the game root, which
records every model the mod met and could not name.

models.name: Michael
models.evidence: Protagonist. The derived name would be 'Player Zero', which is an internal id, not a person.

models.name: Franklin
models.evidence: Protagonist. Negative hash (-1692214353) — one of the rows the old ulong lookup could never reach.

models.name: Online Character
models.evidence: Freemode avatar; the derived name would be 'Freemode'.

models.name: Soda Machine
models.evidence: Derived name is 'Vend Soda' — the model id's word order, not English. This model is also the worked example in the iter-52 interaction-catalogue comment, so it is the one most likely to be checked by hand.

models.name: Coffee Machine
models.evidence: Derived name is 'Vend Coffe' — the game's own spelling is wrong and would be read out as written.

models.name: Cash Machine
models.evidence: 'A T M' is spelled out letter by letter by most screen readers at speed.
